interface.description: Network interface on which to listen for IPv6 DHCPv6 requests.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging output. Options: debug, info, warning, error, critical.

pid_file.description: File path where the process ID will be written.

server_address.description: Link-local or unique-local IPv6 address of the server (used as source for responses).

assign_address.description: Whether to assign IPv6 addresses to clients.

assign_dns.description: Whether to provide DNS server addresses to clients.

assign_ntp.description: Whether to provide NTP server addresses to clients.

assign_domains.description: Whether to provide domain search lists to clients.

dns_servers.description: List of IPv6 DNS server addresses to assign to clients when `assign_dns` is true.

items.description: IPv6 address of a DNS server.

domain_search.description: Domain search list to append to DNS queries for clients.

items.description: Domain name to include in the DNS search list.

ntp_servers.description: List of IPv6 NTP server addresses to assign to clients when `assign_ntp` is true.

items.description: IPv6 address of an NTP server.

lease_time.description: Default lease time (in seconds) for assigned addresses.

max_lease_time.description: Maximum allowed lease time (in seconds) for assigned addresses.

client_classes.description: List of client classes (e.g., for device types, VLANs, or subnets). Each class defines matching rules, subnets, and custom options.

items.description: A named client class with its own configuration.

name.description: Unique name for this client class (e.g., 'phones', 'laptops').

subnets.description: List of subnets for this class.

range_start.description: First address in the dynamic pool (e.g., `2001:db8:1::100`).

range_end.description: Last address in the dynamic pool (e.g., `2001:db8:1::ff`).

router.description: Router address to assign (if not default).

dns_servers.description: Optional list of DNS servers for this class; overrides global DNS if present.

domain_search.description: Optional domain search list for this class.

ntp_servers.description: Optional list of NTP servers for this class.

static_assignments.description: List of static address assignments keyed by client DUID.

items.description: Static assignment for a specific client.

hostname.description: Hostname to assign to this client (if DNS/DHCP integration is enabled).

class.description: Client class this assignment belongs to (for organization).
